title: Senior Linux Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Req ID:** 389304
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Linux Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).
  
  
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence, and ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring, the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
  
  
**Technical Skills Experience:**  

* Proven experience in Linux/UNIX/AIX troubleshooting with a strong foundation in system administration and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience in installing, configuring, and maintaining Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, SUSE).
* Proficiency in High Availability (HA) configuration and management using Pacemaker (PCS CRM) Clusters.
* Expertise in OS patching using cloud-native tools such as Azure AUM, AWS Patch Manager, and GCP VM Manager.
* Solid understanding of networking and performance troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of VMware in GCVE (Google Cloud VMware Engine).
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, SUSE Manager, Oracle Linux Manager, and Oracle Spacewalk.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift (preferred).
* Familiarity with automation and scripting tools such as Shell scripting, Ansible, Python, or any cloud-native shell.
* Strong grasp of ITSM/ITIL processes; certification is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills are essential.

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Manage and support cloud administration, GCVE infrastructure, OS/server patching, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Work across multiple cloud platforms with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.
* Participate in on-call rotations and handle P1/P2 incidents and escalations effectively.
* Develop and maintain knowledge base (KB) articles, problem management documentation, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Provide mentorship and support to L1 support teams.
* Deliver timely, high-quality customer service with strong ownership and accountability.
* Work independently in project environments while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* 7+ years of overall operational experience
* 3+ years of experience working in a diverse cloud support environment in a 24\*7 production support model

**Preferred Certifications:**  

* AWS SysOps Administrator/Developer/Solutions Architect Associate Certifications
* Azure Administrator Associate/Solution Architect Certifications
* GCP Cloud Engineer

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 10 - 14 years
* City Hyderabad
* Country India

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Infrastructure Engineer**

*Senior / Lead Level | Full-Time | Hyderabad or Coimbatore, India (Hybrid/Onsite as applicable)*

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are looking for an experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer with 10–14 years of experience to manage, automate, and secure enterprise infrastructure across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Linux/Windows administration, containerization and orchestration, identity & access management, and infrastructure automation, along with a track record of supporting mission-critical industrial and enterprise applications through their full operational lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and support enterprise server environments and industrial/application infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Design, build, and maintain Helm charts and containerized workloads; lead Docker/Podman to Kubernetes (K3S) migrations and orchestration.
* Integrate applications with centralized identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID, AD, LDAP) using Keycloak to deliver SSO and unified authentication.
* Develop and maintain automation and health-check workflows using Ansible, Python, and Bash to reduce manual operational effort.
* Own CI/CD pipeline design, deployment automation, and GitLab administration, including troubleshooting runner and build failures.
* Drive infrastructure and application vulnerability remediation, OS/kernel patching, and security compliance activities.
* Lead disaster recovery (DR) drills, environment migrations, and release/change deployment activities.
* Provide L2/L3 incident, problem, and change management support following ITIL-aligned processes.
* Coordinate with cross-functional infrastructure, application, and vendor teams on server delivery, patching, and network segmentation.
* Support onboarding of new applications, POCs, and technology evaluations to enhance platform scalability and operational efficiency.
* Manage SSL certificate lifecycle and monitoring/alerting configuration across the environment.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 10–14 years of experience in Linux, Windows, VMware, Cloud, and Automation technologies.
* Hands-on expertise in Ansible, Python, Bash/PowerShell scripting, and Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes (K3S), Helm, Docker, and Podman in production environments.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Experience with identity and access management platforms: LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, and SSO integration.
* Solid understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management practices.

**Technical Skills Matrix**
---------------------------

**Skill Category**

**Representative Tools / Technologies**

DevOps & Automation

Ansible, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Helm, Kubernetes (K3S)

Cloud & Virtualization

AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud (OCI), VMware, Docker, Podman

Operating Systems

Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Solaris), Windows Server

Identity & Security

AD, LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO Integration, Vulnerability Management

Infrastructure & Monitoring

Server Provisioning, Monitoring & Alerting, Disaster Recovery (DR), Performance Tuning

IT Service Management

Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management (ITIL)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) and/or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) or equivalent Microsoft infrastructure certification.
* Prior experience supporting industrial/IoT or retail-technology assets (e.g., self-driving vehicles, smart checkout systems) is a plus.
* Experience with orchestration/flow tools beyond Ansible (e.g., custom automation or low-code flow platforms) is a plus.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer applications, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Reduced manual operational effort through automation of repetitive infrastructure tasks.
* Stable, secure, and audit-ready infrastructure with proactive vulnerability remediation.
* Reliable CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments supporting rapid, low-risk releases.
* Strong cross-team collaboration enabling smooth onboarding of new applications and platforms.

title: Senior Linux and Zabbix Administrator
description:
Job Description – Senior Linux and Zabbix Systems Engineer  
  
Experience  
  
6 8 years of relevant experience in Zabbix administration and Linux server operations.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  
  
Linux Administration:  
. Strong hands on experience in RHEL and Ubuntu administration.  
. L3 level troubleshooting of complex Linux OS, boot, kernel, filesystem, network, and performance issues.  
. Red Hat Satellite administration, including content lifecycle management, patching, repository management, activation keys, and host management.  
. Ubuntu server administration, including patching, upgrades, and advanced troubleshooting.  
. Strong experience with Ansible and infrastructure automation.  
. Support virtualization and cloud infrastructure, including VMware, KVM, Hyper V, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.  
. Support Linux environments hosted on virtualized and cloud platforms, including exposure to AWS infrastructure automation using Ansible.  
. Build, configure, administer, and lifecycle manage physical and virtual Linux servers running RHEL 7/8/9 and Ubuntu.  
. Perform server provisioning, OS installation, configuration, standardization, hardening, patching, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance.  
. Plan and execute RHEL OS upgrades, including RHEL 7 to RHEL 8/9 where applicable, and troubleshoot issues during and after upgrades.  
. Build, configure, and maintain Pacemaker/Corosync/PCS high availability clusters, including cluster resources, resource groups, constraints, quorum, fencing/STONITH, and failover policies.  
. Support clustered environments including SAP HANA on AWS and Pacemaker based HA solutions.  
. Manage core Linux components including systemd, processes, services, users, groups, permissions, sudo, SSH, cron, filesystems, LVM, RAID, and networking.  
. Manage enterprise storage, including LVM, multipathing, NFS, SAN, RAID, and filesystem troubleshooting.  
. Perform advanced troubleshooting and L3 level root cause analysis of Linux OS, boot, kernel, filesystem, network, storage, application, and performance issues.  
. Analyze system logs and troubleshoot boot failures, kernel issues, critical services, connectivity problems, and resource related incidents.  
. Perform performance tuning and capacity management for CPU, memory, disk I/O, filesystems, and network resources.  
. Manage Linux networking, including DNS, routing, bonding, firewall configuration, and connectivity troubleshooting.  
. Implement and maintain Linux security controls, including SELinux, firewalls, PAM, SSH security, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.  
. Administer Red Hat Satellite, including content lifecycle management, repository management, patching, activation keys, and host management.  
. Perform OS patching and security updates in accordance with organizational standards and vulnerability management requirements.  
. Automate administrative and infrastructure tasks using Bash/Shell scripting, Python, and Ansible.  
. Develop and maintain Ansible automation for server provisioning, configuration, patching, and infrastructure management.  
. Manage production incidents, service requests, problems, and changes within agreed SLAs and 24x7 operational environments.  
. Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical and recurring infrastructure issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.  
. Coordinate with application, database, storage, network, security, and cloud teams for infrastructure operations and issue resolution.  
. Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.  
. Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and contribute to knowledge management and operational improvement.  
  
Zabbix Administration:  
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Zabbix Server, Zabbix Agents, and Zabbix Proxies.  
Configure monitoring for Linux servers, applications, databases, network devices, and other infrastructure components.  
Create and maintain hosts, host groups, templates, items, triggers, discovery rules, actions, and dashboards.  
Configure Zabbix agents and agent based monitoring across Linux servers.  
Develop and customize monitoring templates based on operational requirements.  
Configure thresholds, triggers, alerts, and notification mechanisms.  
Troubleshoot Zabbix monitoring failures, false alerts, and agent connectivity issues.  
Perform Zabbix upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and health checks.  
Manage Zabbix users, roles, authentication, and access permissions.  
Configure and troubleshoot Zabbix proxies in distributed monitoring environments.  
Analyze monitoring trends and identify recurring infrastructure issues.  
Maintain Zabbix documentation, monitoring standards, and operational procedures.

title: Linux Infrastructure Administrator - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Linux Infrastructure Administrator to join the DCOPS Linux Operations team in Pune. You will provide advanced technical support across Linux infrastructure, diagnose complex hardware and operating-system issues, and manage incidents, service requests and changes within agreed service-level commitments.

As a senior technical authority within the team, you will lead complex troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and permanent remediation. You will also support critical incidents, contribute to infrastructure maintenance and migrations, improve technical standards, and help optimise Linux services through automation and architectural enhancements. The position includes on-call responsibilities as part of a 24x7 support model.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Provide technical support for Linux infrastructure and resolve complex hardware and operating-system issues.
* Administer and troubleshoot RHEL Linux and Oracle Linux environments.
* Manage server-related incidents, service requests and change requests within defined service-level commitments.
* Act as a senior technical authority and provide guidance on complex operational issues.
* Lead advanced troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and the implementation of permanent fixes.
* Support P1 and P2 incidents, major service outages and performance-related issues.
* Perform Linux infrastructure maintenance and migration activities.
* Recommend improvements that enhance platform stability, service performance and operational efficiency.
* Define and improve technical standards, standard operating procedures and best practices.
* Mentor L1 and L2 teams and provide technical guidance.
* Collaborate across products, vendors and geographical locations to develop effective solutions.
* Contribute to architectural improvements, automation design and optimisation initiatives.
* Participate in an on-call rota to support 24x7 operations.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have strong knowledge of RHEL Linux and Oracle Linux administration.
* You have practical experience diagnosing and resolving Linux hardware, operating-system and performance issues.
* You understand enterprise incident, service-request and change-management processes.
* You can lead complex troubleshooting and structured root-cause analysis.
* You have experience supporting business-critical P1 and P2 incidents and major outages.
* You can develop permanent fixes and recommend improvements to platform stability and performance.
* You have knowledge of Veritas Cluster Server, DRCC and Microsoft Azure.
* You can create and improve technical standards, operating procedures and best practices.
* You can guide and mentor L1 and L2 technical teams.
* You work effectively with cross-functional teams, vendors and colleagues across different geographical locations.
* You communicate clearly and apply open-minded, solution-oriented thinking.
* You are comfortable participating in an on-call rota within a 24x7 operational support environment.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* An opportunity to work with enterprise-scale Linux infrastructure in a business-critical data-centre operations environment.
* Exposure to RHEL Linux, Oracle Linux, Veritas Cluster Server, DRCC and Microsoft Azure.
* Opportunities to lead complex troubleshooting, critical-incident resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Scope to influence technical standards, operating procedures, automation and infrastructure optimisation.
* Experience collaborating with product teams, vendors and colleagues across multiple geographical locations.
* Opportunities to mentor technical colleagues and develop deeper technical leadership capabilities.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced troubleshooting across enterprise Linux platforms.
* Structured management of critical incidents, major outages and performance issues.
* Root-cause analysis and the design of sustainable corrective actions.
* Linux infrastructure maintenance and migration planning.
* Automation design and operational optimisation.
* Development of technical standards, best practices and standard operating procedures.
* Cross-functional and vendor collaboration in a distributed operational environment.
* Technical mentoring and knowledge-sharing across L1 and L2 support teams.
* Broader integration knowledge across Linux, clustering, disaster-recovery and cloud technologies.
